headline: Capstone Copper Delivers Record EBITDA in Third Quarter 2026
summary: Capstone Copper announced record quarterly EBITDA during the third quarter of 2026, supported by operational performance across its copper mining assets in the Americas.
why: Capstone Copper is a mid-tier copper producer with major mining assets across the Americas, levered to rising electrification demand.

impacts.name: Capstone Copper Corp.
impacts.why: Record EBITDA underscores robust production volumes and healthy margins.
